answers.core: Implementing this as an add-on would be a lot less elegant and likely require use of file streams and `ProjectSettings.globalize_path()`, as well as reloading the config file or locking it while the operation is performed.
answers.workaround: Depending on the application, yes.  Users with full control over the input data can design around the limitations of ConfigFile however they please, but the only option they have within `ConfigFile` itself to remove expired or now-useless keys is to erase an entire section.
